Sequence context rule. 
ContextSubst = object
  format*: uint16            ## Table format 1 to 6.
  coverage*: Coverage        ## First glyph coverage.
  classDef*: ClassDef        ## Input class definition for format 2 and 5.
  ruleSets*: seq[seq[ContextRule]] ## Rule sets per coverage index or class.
  coverages*: seq[Coverage]  ## Per position coverages for format 3 and 6.
  records*: seq[LookupRecord] ## Nested lookups for format 3 and 6.
Sequence context substitution. 
GsubData = ref object
  scripts*: seq[tuple[tag: uint32, script: ScriptTable]] ## Script records.
  features*: seq[tuple[tag: uint32, lookups: seq[uint16]]] ## Features with lookup indices.
  lookups*: seq[Lookup] ## Lookup cache, filled on demand.
                        ## On-demand lookup cache. `parseGsubTable` (raw bytes) parses
                        ## eagerly; `parseGsub` (font) parses scripts and features eagerly
                        ## but defers lookup bodies until first use. Direct `.lookups[]`
                        ## indexing bypasses the cache: use `getGsubLookup` so placeholders
                        ## get parsed before use.
  font*: SfntFont            ## Font keeping table bytes alive.
  lookupBase*: int           ## Lookup list base offset.
  offsets*: seq[int]         ## Per lookup table offsets.
  parsed*: seq[bool]         ## Per lookup parse state.
Parsed GSUB table. A ref so shaping passes a pointer instead of deep-copying megabytes of parsed lookups per call (Nim seq = copies). All shapes through one ShaperFont share the handle, and deferred lookup bodies fill the cache on first use.

  lkContext,                ## Contextual substitution.
  lkChain,                  ## Chained contextual substitution.
  lkReverse,                ## Reverse chaining substitution.
  lkOther                    ## Unsupported lookup type.
GSUB subtable kind.

Lookup = object

  ligatureSubsts*: seq[LigatureSubst] ## Ligature substitution subtables.

SingleSubst = object
  coverage*: Coverage        ## Covered first glyphs.
  wide*: bool                ## True for 24 bit ids.
  case kind*: SingleSubstKind
  of ssDelta:

  of ssArray:

Single glyph substitution. Discriminated by kind. 
SingleSubstKind = enum

  ssArray                    ## Explicit substitute list form.
Single substitution storage.

Returns the parsed lookup, parsing and caching on first use when the table was built lazily via parseGsub. The table is a ref so the cache fills through value copies without var threading.
